fields.System.Title: EPIC CNT — Inventory Counting
fields.System.Description:
Goal

Verify that the system's numbers match the shelf, correct them when they do not, and produce
the data that shows why they drifted.

Business value

Inventory accuracy is not a feature you build once. It degrades continuously through small
process failures, and counting is the only thing that pushes back.

The second half of the goal matters as much as the first. A count that corrects a number
treats the symptom. A count whose variance data shows that one zone, one product class, or one
operator produces most of the drift treats the cause.

Scope

In. Count plans and ABC classification. Scheduled, event-triggered, and targeted counts.
Blind count entry. Location freezing. Variance calculation, recount thresholds, approval, and
posting. Accuracy reporting. Full physical counts.

Out. Financial stock valuation. Statutory year-end reporting formats.

Done when

  • A count plan generates tasks on an ABC schedule.
  • A zero pick triggers a count of that location.
  • The count client never receives the expected quantity, in any field.
  • A location is frozen for the duration of its count.
  • Variance is calculated against the snapshot taken at freeze time.
  • A variance above threshold requires a recount before any adjustment.
  • Accuracy trends are reportable by zone, product class, and operator.

Key risks

| Risk | Why it matters | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Stock moves during the count | Variances are timing artefacts; trust collapses | [doc 09 §6.1](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Expected quantity visible to the counter | Counts always match; real accuracy unknown | [doc 09 §6.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Only one batch counted | Phantom variance on the uncounted batch | [doc 09 §6.3](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Recount compared to the adjusted figure | The problem disappears from the record | [doc 09 §6.4](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Adjustment posted twice on retry | Corrupted by its own correction | [doc 09 §3.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Counting a location with open tasks | Guaranteed variance | [doc 09 §6.5](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
